description: Settings related to the solution of a constrained linear system.

reordering.description: Reordering strategy to execute before passing the system to the linear solver.

write-unconstrained-lhs.description: Path to write the LHS matrix to, or null.

write-unconstrained-rhs.description: Path to write the RHS vector to, or null.

write-unconstrained-solution.description: Path to write the solution vector to after execution, or null.
